name: google_trending_searches
description: What is trending on Google today/right now? Returns the current daily trending Google search terms for a country, each with Google's approximate traffic floor (for example "1000+") and related news articles. Keyless. This is the live trending-search snapshot, not historical interest-over-time data.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code (default US), e.g. US, GB, CA, IN, AU.
